goal: issue34 observable fingerprints follow actual decoding, URL resolution, selected metadata, and declared volume order

cases.control: identical HTTP entity bytes and request URL; UTF-8 versus Windows-1252 Content-Type charset
cases.failure: a successfully decoded different text is silently unchanged
cases.assert: same stable Resource and parser; changed input fingerprint and new Version when declared decoding changes text

cases.control: same entry URL redirects to base-a versus base-b; final entity bytes identical and contain a relative link; no link discovery
cases.failure: actual document base is omitted from semantic input
cases.assert: Resource identity stays entry URL; actual final base change produces new Version/input fingerprint, stable parser

cases.control: article content XPath stays byte-identical; published_at XPath selects external date span; only selected date changes
cases.failure: selected external date is ignored or parser is spuriously changed
cases.assertion: selected date changes projected publication date and Version while Markdown stays fixed; whole HTML is a business original, so unselected HTML-byte changes may legitimately create versions

cases.control: two unchanged distinct PDF originals; link DOM order changes without labels, then Part 1/Part 2 labels explicitly swap
cases.failure: DOM order churns Version or declared file order swap is ignored
cases.assert: DOM reorder unchanged; declared contiguous volume order changes Version and reverses file_hash to file_order mapping

immutability: prior Version/Observation rows, Snapshot A coverage/results and every authorized files byte stream remain fixed after B
isolation: fresh database/bucket for each child case, controlled HTTP origin, actual CLI and API only, no src reads or writes
